pending.description: IES Eval Harness — 4-Tier Assessment Framework. Full system instrumentation for workflows, skills, and agents with automated Tier 1 (mechanical success/fail), Tier 2 (structural assertions), Tier 3 (on-demand letter grading), and Tier 4 (controller feedback sampling) assessment. Includes 4 hook scripts wired into Claude Code lifecycle (SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostToolUseFailure, SessionEnd), 6 assertion definition files covering all major workflows and the eval skills themselves, 3 new skills (rigby-eval-grade, rigby-eval-analyze, rigby-eval-dashboard), an HTML dashboard generator, eval schema, and integration into weekly-review, daily-review, and evolution-deployment workflows. Post-build adversarial review applied 15 fixes: Tier 2 assertion lookup (name over agent-type), Tier 1 no longer overwrites with hardcoded values, agent_id stored in stubs for reliable correlation, yaml import moved to top-level, tool_failure increments preserved through stop hook, failure_entry attached to records, all hooks use IES_ROOT env var, atomic writes with fcntl locking, trigger detection from state.yaml, log_error/log_info separated, weekly-review step-08 owns workflow close, daily-review and evolution-deployment assertion files added, self-assertion files for eval skills, benchmark snapshot comparison clarified as deferred, and weekly-review routing table corrected.

SubagentStart hook — creates eval record stub with agent_id (for reliable correlation), type, name, session_id, and initialized 4-tier assessment block. Uses atomic writes with fcntl locking. IES_ROOT from env var.

SubagentStop hook — completes eval record: reads existing Tier 1 mechanical state (not overwritten), runs Tier 2 assertions (lookup by name then agent-type), correlates error entries, computes version_hash from workflow.md/SKILL.md, derives status (success/failure/partial/aborted) from real data. yaml imported at top-level. Atomic writes.
PostToolUseFailure hook — increments tool_failures counter and appends full failure_entry (tool, error, duration_ms, timestamp) to tool_failure_log in the active eval record. Atomic writes.
SessionEnd hook — marks any in-progress eval records as aborted with abort_reason. Uses log_info (not log_error) for normal session-end events. Atomic writes.
